::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Aug 12th [1873][^1]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection C0171: Box 29
:::

Dear [Miss Medhurst](people/person_988.qmd),
Thanks for your poem. You will probably be here on Saturday in time for am [sic] morning service, which is at ten o’clock.

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Dated on the assumption that the poem was  'New Year's Eve', which was published in *MP* in December 1873.
